- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is 162.31 billion, with a gross margin of 40.2% and an EBITDA margin of 16.7%.
- The company that contributes most to the revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare with 97.41 billion, and the one that needs attention is Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery with lower margins of 36.2% gross and 14.8% EBITDA.
- Margins for the scope are 40.2% gross and 16.7% EBITDA, indicating a relatively stable profitability.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is managed with 69 days of DSO and 79 days of DPO.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with a change of 4.08 billion (37.9% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with a change of 2.47 billion (23% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with a change of 2.05 billion (19.1% of total change).
